_disclaimer: SAMPLE REFERENCE DATA FOR DEMONSTRATION ONLY. NOT LEGAL ADVICE. These lists are simplified illustrations of documents commonly gathered for each case type. Actual requirements depend on the individual case and current agency rules, and must be set by a licensed attorney.

H-1B Work Visa.description: Employer-sponsored temporary work visa for a specialty occupation.
filing_forms: Form I-129, Petition for a Nonimmigrant Worker

Family-Based Green Card.description: Permanent residence based on marriage to a U.S. citizen.
filing_forms: Form I-130, Petition for Alien Relative
Form I-485, Application to Register Permanent Residence or Adjust Status
required_documents: Photos and correspondence showing the relationship
Sponsor's most recent federal tax return

Asylum.description: Protection for a person who fears persecution in their home country.
filing_forms: Form I-589, Application for Asylum and for Withholding of Removal
required_documents: Supporting evidence (police, medical, or news records)

Naturalization.description: U.S. citizenship for an eligible lawful permanent resident.
required_documents: Travel history: trips outside the U.S. (last 5 years)
Federal tax returns or IRS transcripts (last 5 years)
